 Print Surat: Jewellery and cash worth Rs 4.66 lakh were stolen from the Surat home of a police sub-inspector while his family was away in Bhavnagar for the Diwali holidays. According to the FIR lodged at Jahangirpura police station, the theft took place between Nov 9 and Nov 15 when the flat was locked. G D Parmar, a sub-inspector posted at Ashwinikumar police station, had left for Bhavnagar with his family on Nov 9. They locked their flat on the second floor of Sakar Apartments before leaving. On Nov 15, the chairman of the housing society alerted the family that the door of their flat was open and a theft seemed to have taken place. When the family returned to Surat, they found household articles strewn across the rooms and valuables missing from cupboards. Join conversation

 Police said the burglars entered the house and searched the bedrooms before fleeing with cash and jewellery. The stolen property includes eight gold and silver ornaments valued at Rs 3.86 lakh and Rs 80,000 in cash, taking the total loss to Rs 4.66 lakh. The missing jewellery included gold chains, rings, earrings and silver jewellery. Parmar’s wife later approached the police and lodged a complaint.
